disagreements.text: Everyone blames the hill at 18 miles. I split the field into people who ran the first half under 1:45 and over, and the slowdown after 18 was almost identical for both groups. If the hill were the problem the fast starters would fall apart harder.
Every injury thread on this forum is the same injury and the same three replies.
First run back after eight weeks out. Two miles, slower than my warm-up used to be, and I don't care even slightly.
Signed up. Card's charged, no going back, immediately regret everything.
